title: The New Blood challenges the Millionaire’s Club
summary: Vince Russo and Eric Bischoff reset WCW around a generational conflict. Their favored wrestlers claim the established stars have blocked their opportunities, with Jeff Jarrett positioned as a leading beneficiary.

chapters.title: All championships are vacated
chapters.result: Russo and Bischoff declare every WCW title vacant.
chapters.context: The on-screen reset pits the New Blood against the veteran Millionaire’s Club.

chapters.title: Jarrett wins the vacant world title
chapters.result: Jarrett defeats DDP in the championship tournament final.
chapters.context: The New Blood’s chosen contender takes the leading championship at the first pay-per-view after the reset.
